title: docs(skills): the data skill teaches the three permission axes, viewAllFields and the sensitivity tiers
body:
Fixes #36053

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:用数据技能包写应用的 AI 助手,以前只学到「查看全部 / 修改全部」这一种放权方式,现在学到权限分三件事(能不能用这个对象、能看到哪些记录、能看到哪些字段),「这个角色能读所有字段」有专门的写法,工资、证件号这类高敏感字段要在字段上加门槛;权限文档页同步说明。
- 为什么做:属于「权限三轴」这项已裁决的工作的第二步,读全部字段的新写法已经上线,技能包和文档没跟上,AI 会照旧模型写出到 v19 要返工的权限配置。
- 出错会怎样:最坏是 AI 读到的说明不够准确,不改变任何运行行为;可以直接撤回本次合并。
- 要你做什么:这是对外发布的技能包,需要你审核批准后才能合并。

## What changes

- `skills/objectstack-data/rules/security.md`: the bits bullet now names the three axes (object permission, record scope, fields) and says that from v19 View All / Modify All open no field. A new section, "Field visibility and `viewAllFields`", teaches the three sensitivity tiers (ordinary: write nothing; position-dependent: `fields` rows; high-sensitivity: `requiredPermissions` on the field) and `viewAllFields: true` (a read vote on every field, never an edit vote; the set's own `readable: false` row beats it; no object access and no record; on `'*'` it also votes on a private-posture object's fields; authored in metadata, Studio has no control for it). The `requiredPermissions` paragraph now says it is strictest-wins over field rows, `viewAllFields`, View All and Modify All, and shows `maskingRule` beside it.
- `skills/objectstack-data/evals/hooks-security-seeds-datasources.json`: two cases, id 36 (a read-everything auditor set written with `viewAllFields`) and id 37 (salary and ID-number fields gated with `requiredPermissions` and `maskingRule`).
- `content/docs/permissions/field-level-security.mdx`: new sections "The three axes", "Choosing by sensitivity" and "`viewAllFields`: a set that reads every field"; `authorization.mdx` and `permissions-matrix.mdx` each gain the "from v19" sentence where they taught View All as reaching every field.
- `packages/spec/src/security/permission.zod.ts`: two docblock sentences, comments only (the review notes carried on the card): the `viewAllFields` no-op claim is scoped to the object entry, and the `FieldPermissionSchema` docblock names `viewAllFields` as a voter.
- Two pins for the posture-blind wildcard vote: `packages/core/src/security/superuser-field-vote-33828.test.ts` and `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/fls-own-field-mask-33828.test.ts`.
- `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`: the `rules/security.md` ceiling row moves 4068 to 4292, on the ratchet header's standing-ruling path (record 6513306068, 「A:先削重复,余额按实测提高」): 274 bytes of restatement were cut first, and the row is raised by the measured remainder only, pinned at the measurement with zero headroom. The claim's amendment 1 on the card records this route.
- Changeset: `@objectstack/skills` patch, `@objectstack/spec` patch.

## Why

The ruling behind the card is that an AI-authored app should get the permission model right by construction. `viewAllFields` is on main, and the published data skill still taught View All / Modify All as the only wide grant, so an author granted View All to open fields. From v19 that stops working.
